label: A formula is a NECESSARY_16 tautology iff it is NECESSARY_14 K-valid and box-free
paraphrase: For every atom type and formula: the formula is a NECESSARY_16 tautology if and only if it is NECESSARY_14 K-valid (true at every world of every small frame under every valuation) and belongs to the truth-functional fragment. A premise-free comparison; it asserts none of the three.
